visual.title: Customer operations, in one place.
visual.body: Provision tenants, manage licenses and maintain the Force 5 product catalog from a focused internal workspace.

login.title: Welcome back
login.lead: Sign in to manage customer accounts, products, licenses and provisioning.
login.timeout: You were signed out after a period of inactivity. Sign in again to continue.
login.invalid: The email or password is incorrect.
login.unavailable: Service unavailable. Sign-in is temporarily down — please try again in a few minutes.
login.forbidden: This account doesn’t have access to the Force 5 CRM.
login.rateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.

selectAccount.title: Choose an account
selectAccount.lead: Your sign-in belongs to more than one account. Pick the one you want to work in.
selectAccount.useDifferent: Sign in with a different email
selectAccount.expired: Your sign-in step expired. Please sign in again.

mfa.title: Verify it’s you
mfa.leadSmsNoDest: We sent a 6-digit code to your mobile phone.
mfa.leadTotp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.resent: A new code is on its way.
mfa.invalid: That code is incorrect or has expired.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.emailLead: Enter the email address you use to sign in. If it matches an account, we’ll send a recovery code.
forgot.sentNotice: If an account exists for {{email}}, a recovery code is on its way. Check your inbox (and spam folder).
forgot.codeLead: Enter the code from the email.
forgot.codeInvalid: That code is incorrect or has expired.
forgot.success: Your password has been reset. Sign in with your new password.
